summary: Mapping local times adds UTC offsets to transition timestamps. At i64 extremes, these additions overflow or underflow, causing a panic with overflow checks or wrapped boundaries and incorrect mappings without them. The fix uses saturating_add for both boundaries, preserving comparisons for representable local times. The regression test added by the fix exercises both extremes. This plan has not been executed.
